purpose: Measure the intrinsic mucin-charge dependence of colicin transport around one identical fixed source, replacing the source-density-confounded nearest-source radius used by the receptor-selection Stage C transport analysis.

arms.producer: one ColE1 producer plus three toxin-blind bystanders
arms.toxin_free_null: identical geometry with the producer's ColE1 plasmid removed

controlled_source_geometry: Exactly one plasmid-bearing cell exists, so exactly one release source can ever exist.
All cells have mu_max=0, so no division creates a second producer and no cell moves by growth.
Bystanders carry no bacteriocin locus, so they are never SOS-induced and never release toxin; they exist only to keep the global agent count above the population-stop threshold.
Bystander BtuB expression is zero, so the toxin field has no receptor sink and the measured profile is transport, not consumption.

Initial placement is drawn before any amplitude-dependent state is consumed, so the source position is identical across the three amplitude arms of one seed; the analyzer asserts this rather than assuming it.
Initial placement is confined to a 2 um band at mid-depth so the analyzed radial support is fully inside the domain for every draw.

predeclared_analysis.source_time: The exact simulation clock of the lysis event, read from provenance event_time_s; provenance-export time is refused.
predeclared_analysis.analysis_window_s: event_time_s < t <= event_time_s + 1500 (five release timescales); the snapshot coincident with the lysis step is excluded because the grid may be exported before the burst's first chemistry application
predeclared_analysis.shell_averaging: Fixed 2 um spherical shells centred on the source; a shell value is the unweighted arithmetic mean of the concentrations of the voxel centres with radius in [r_lo, r_hi) (measure dr).
predeclared_analysis.boundary_handling: Minimum-image distance in periodic x and y, plain distance in non-periodic z, no image sources. A requested support larger than the in-domain support is an error, never a silent trim.
predeclared_analysis.profile_r50_r90: Shell means are converted to radial mass density mean(r) * r^2 and accumulated over the support; rXX is the radius where the normalized cumulative mass first reaches XX/100, linearly interpolated between shell centres and from F(0)=0 inside the first shell.
predeclared_analysis.paired_times: Amplitude arms of one seed are compared only at snapshot times all three arms observed. A missing paired time blocks the assay; per-arm medians are never taken over different times.

criteria: all 12 runs returned an output file

every run authenticates against the execution source SHA, device_delivery (requires metabolism.uptake_limit=delivery so the device delivery path is exercised), one rank, its seed and amplitude, kd_corrinoid_btuB=1e-4, b12_initial_conc=1e-3, burst_release_tau=300 s, the ColE1 pI/diffusion/burst-size identity, and the grid/provenance schedules
every producer run recorded exactly one strain-1 LYSIS provenance event carrying exact event timing
the source position is identical across the three amplitudes of a seed to 1e-12 m and its in-domain radial support is at least 40 um
paired snapshot times are complete across the three amplitudes of every seed
at every paired time in the analysis window and every seed, profile r50 decreases with amplitude 0 > 15 > 60 by at least 0.5 um and profile r90 by at least 0.1 um
at every paired time in the analysis window and every seed, the 0-10 um near-field mean increases with amplitude 0 < 15 < 60
every analyzed shell contains at least one voxel centre and every analyzed value is finite
gate.margin_provenance: Margins are set from a three-amplitude single-seed pilot of this exact configuration (600 s horizon, seed 20260913): r50 28.72/27.22/25.44 um and r90 37.25/36.95/36.51 um, so the separations to exceed are ~1.5 um for r50 and ~0.30 um for r90. r90 separates weakly because the outer profile is dominated by the shared radial support, which is why r50 carries the wider margin.
gate.consumes: nothing; this assay is an instrument check of the transport law and does not by itself promote a mucin-charge amplitude
